role: Preregistered contract for the v0.4.1 2D viscosity inverse. It does not edit any v0.4 artifact. It fixes the calibration split, the FNO-bracket warm start, the metrics, and the same v0.4 pass bars before the test split is scored. It holds no v0.4.1 test number.
question: With a calibration split of at least 60 instances disjoint from train and test, can an FNO-located conformal bracket plus a short local solver search recover a scalar viscosity on the same 2D Burgers and vorticity-form Navier-Stokes problems, against the frozen v0.4 pass bars?

diagnosis.role: Why v0.4 failed, cited from the frozen v0.4 scores. These are not v0.4.1 test numbers.
diagnosis.calibration_degeneracy: v0.4 used n_val = 8. The split-conformal rank ceil((n + 1)(1 - alpha)) is 9, so the quantile is infinite and empirical coverage is 1, outside [0.85, 0.95].
diagnosis.fno_too_poor_to_seed: v0.4 treated the FNO inverse as a Gauss-Newton seed. The hybrid FNO inverse complement mean relative error was 0.5231465619444131 on Burgers and 0.7441866512832163 on Navier-Stokes. Two or three Gauss-Newton steps moved the hybrid warm-start complement error only to 0.168616089900106 and 0.3245006510224735, still above the 0.05 in-distribution bar and far from the cold solver (0.004404494487213693 on Burgers complement).

causes_considered.data_volume: 24 training instances, width 12, modes 6, layers 2, 10 epochs. That budget is small for 64 by 64 fields. This protocol does not increase the training set or the network; the chosen lever is the inverse, not a larger FNO.
causes_considered.resolution: The 64 by 64 spectral labels passed the v0.4 refinement gate. The inverse failure is not a failed forward solver.
causes_considered.sensor_lift: An 8 by 8 lattice recovers the bandlimited Burgers initial field, so Burgers oracle-IC and sensor-lift cold errors match. Navier-Stokes vorticity is not recovered by that lift, so the sensor-lift objective is harder. The FNO still fails on Burgers, where the lift is faithful.
causes_considered.training_budget: 10 epochs and a 21-point inverse grid cap the FNO point estimate. More epochs would be a different study.

diagnosis.chosen_fix: Do not seed Gauss-Newton at the FNO point. Use the FNO inverse only to locate a split-conformal log-bracket, then run a short local solver search inside that bracket. Calibrate both the bracket and the reported interval on a split of at least 60 instances disjoint from train and test.

not_claimed: a result on The Well shear_flow or Petrobras 3W
that the warm start is more accurate than the cold search; the bar is accuracy within a factor of the cold search
coverage conditional on viscosity, on noise level, or outside the training range
that the abstain flag detects every large error
a retuned hard_ood rule after seeing test scores
an architecture, width, mode count, or loss weight that is optimal outside this frozen set
speed-ups on other machines, GPUs, or other solvers
a change to any v0.4 number, protocol, or score file
that a larger FNO or a longer training run would have passed v0.4

aggregation.unit: one scalar per seed per slice

domain.grid: x_j = L * j / N, j = 0..N-1, last node identified with the first
domain.wavenumber: k_m = 2 * pi * m / L in numpy.fft order; Nyquist derivative multiplier is 0

hard_ood.name: hard_ood
hard_ood.rule: threshold_nu is the lower quartile of the training-split viscosities, computed once after generation and stored in the pilot manifest. It is not refit on calibration or test.

splits.assignment: by instance id before any windowing: train 0..n_train-1, calibration n_train..n_train+n_cal-1, test n_train+n_cal..total-1
splits.note: n_val equals n_cal so the existing generator's val slot is the calibration split. The generator is not given test labels.

initial.amplitude: Uniform(-1, 1) / sqrt(m_x^2 + m_y^2) for each retained mode of each component, then max-abs normalized to 1

ns2d.pde: ω_t + u · ∇ω = nu Δω + f,  u = ∇^⊥ ψ,  −Δψ = ω

kolmogorov.form: f(x, y) = -k cos(k y) with k = 4, the curl of velocity forcing (sin(k y), 0)

initial.spectrum: amplitudes Uniform(-1, 1) / (1 + m_x^2 + m_y^2), then max-abs normalized to 1

convergence.test: reuse the committed v0.4 refinement record; do not rerun as an inverse pass bar

sensors.name: sensors64_lattice_bursts
sensors.layout: 8 by 8 equispaced lattice, stride 8 on the 64 by 64 grid, identical for every instance

noise.model: additive iid Gaussian on observed field values, scaled by the clean-field standard deviation of that instance
noise.calibration: clean calibration split only; nothing is refit for noise

closed_form_ls.estimator: normal equation of the lifted discrete residual after a trigonometric interpolant from the 8x8 sensors onto the 64x64 grid

weak_form.estimator: WSINDy-style compact polynomial test functions on the sensor lattice, trapezoidal quadrature, no interpolation of the field

fno_forward_data.role: 2D FNO trained with normalized data MSE

fno_forward_hybrid.role: 2D FNO trained with data MSE plus a discrete PDE residual

fno_inverse.role: FNO-conditioned inverse; locates the bracket, not the reported point estimate of the primary method
fno_inverse.objective: sensor mean square of a rollout from the lifted opening burst, over a frozen viscosity grid

solver_sensor_ic.initial_condition: trigonometric lift of the opening-burst sensors

search.forward_model: the same spectral solver that built the labels

solver_oracle_ic.initial_condition: true full field at the opening frame

warm_start.role: primary method when paired with the hybrid FNO inverse
warm_start.first_guess: fno_inverse on the same arm, used only to locate a bracket

bracket.quantile: the ceil((n + 1)(1 - alpha))-th smallest calibration score of the FNO inverse, n = n_cal >= 60

local_search.algorithm: equispaced sensor-residual evaluations inside the bracket; keep the minimizer
local_search.n_local_selection: smallest n_local with calibration hard_ood time_ratio <= 0.2 whose mean hard_ood relative error is within a factor 1.02 of the best such n_local; if none, the fastest n_local
local_search.initial_condition: trigonometric lift of the opening-burst sensors

intervals.quantile: the ceil((n + 1)(1 - alpha))-th smallest calibration score of the warm-start point, n = n_cal >= 60
intervals.groups: predicted_hard_ood if nu_hat <= threshold_nu, else predicted_complement
intervals.small_group: a group with fewer than min_group calibration rows uses the pooled quantile

abstain.threshold: the ceil(n (1 - rate))-th smallest calibration statistic; abstain when strictly above

fno.normalization: training-split field mean/std and viscosity mean/std only

pass_bars.source: identical to docs/v04/protocol.json pass_bars; not retuned
pass_bars.aggregation: arithmetic mean over the five seeds of the per-seed slice statistic

hard_ood_gap.statement: hard_ood mean relative error / complement mean relative error <= 3

warm_vs_cold.error_statement: hard_ood mean relative error <= 1.5 x the cold solver_sensor_ic hard_ood mean relative error measured in the same run
warm_vs_cold.time_statement: hard_ood mean warm-start wall clock <= 0.25 x the hard_ood mean cold-search wall clock, both measured in this run

coverage.statement: full_test empirical coverage of the nominal 0.9 interval in [0.85, 0.95]

pass_bars.overall: pass only if all four bars pass on the primary problem and method. The same bars are scored on ns2d and published as pass or fail without retuning.

reported_not_bars: abstain rate and error on accepted instances
forward relative L2 of the 2D FNO
the FNO-only conformal coverage of the bracket

compute.gpu: optional notebook scripts/v041_colab.py; if used, commit hashes and a reproducibility note. CI never trains the study.
compute.ci: tiny smoke only: N=8, two time steps, one untrained FNO forward, one manufactured inverse residual, one bracket construction
